title: Sesuji's About a Pilgrimage to the Defiled Sacred Grounds Novel Gets Live-Action Film in 2027
content: Flag Pictures announced on Thursday that Sesuji 's About a Pilgrimage to the Defiled Sacred Grounds ( Kegareta Seichijunrei ni Tsuite ) novel is inspiring a live-action film that will open in Japan in 2027.
author: ANN

title: Blood Addict Manga Ends
content: The December issue of Square Enix 's G Fantasy magazine announced on Wednesday that Umiharu 's Blood Addict ( Bloodict ) manga will end in the next issue on December 18. Manga UP!

title: K Manga Adds Godmother Manga
content: Kodansha 's K MANGA platform announced on Tuesday that it has added Rin Shimokawa 's Godmother manga as a simulpub title. The platform describes the story: "Who should these children call 'Grandma' after I pass away?" Kinryu, a Chinese college student, was suddenly told to move to Japan.
author: ANN

title: Netflix’s Solo Leveling Update Reveals It’s Aiming to Perfect One Role That the Anime Forgot
content: The latest update on Netflix’s Solo Leveling live-action adaptation hints at perfecting one role that the original series didn’t. Solo Leveling is a power fantasy series focused on a man who aims to become the best version of himself, acquiring wealth and power for himself and his family.
author: ComicBook

title: Hiromasa Okujima Announces 1st Original Boys-Love Manga
content: Hiromasa Okujima announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Wednesday a new "yankee" boys-love manga that will launch with Manga Box 's new Comic Fetto label in 2027, with a possible release window in summer. According to the artist, this marks his first original boys-love manga.

title: 5 1990s Anime Classics That Still Hit Today
content: When it comes to anime classics, t he 1990s was a different era altogether . It was the most revolutionary time for the anime industry since the medium broke into the global mainstream.

title: Duel Masters GT Manga Gets 4th Part
content: Shogakukan 's Weekly CoroCoro Comic manga website announced on Wednesday that Hiroki Kikuzuma and Daisuke Kawasaki 's Duel Masters GT manga will continue in a new arc. Duel Masters GT3 -Glitch of the Twin Heart- , the third part of the series, ended on the same day.
author: ANN

title: Dragon Ball Super Needs to Reveal More of Its Multiverse
content: The entirety of Dragon Ball Super ‘s 131 episode, two-movie run discussed only a small portion of its multiverse. The anime focused on Universe 7, which is where the Z Fighters are located, and specifically Universes 6 and 11 got extended attention compared to the rest.

title: Demon Slayer Was a Huge Disappointment This Year & It’s Not Because of Infinity Castle
content: 2026 marks the 10th anniversary of the manga debut of Demon Slayer , a Weekly Shonen Jump hit written and illustrated by Koyoharu Gotouge. The series has been on the rise of popular ever since then, but things took a drastic turn after the anime debut by Ufotable in 2019.
